item.title: Amazon uses union-busting AI surveillance to monitor union risk in UK warehouses
item.description:
📝 Garfield Hylton has long known that Amazon monitors and logs every minute of his working day. The lower the score, the more likely Atlas believes workers – whom Amazon calls ‘associates’ – in that warehouse are to unionise or take other actions that could impact Amazon’s productivity or profitability. Everyone knows that Amazon is heavy on surveillance, but this becomes more personal.
🔗 Read more: https://www.opendemocracy.net/amazon-ai-surveillance-monitor-union-activity-uk-warehouses-birmingham-coventry-atlas-sutton-coldfield/
